title: Fence Painting & Staining in Chiefland, FL
description: Fence painting and staining in Chiefland, FL for wood and vinyl fences: algae removal, board repair, and stain, sealer, or paint chosen for your fence.
h1: Fence Painting and Staining in Chiefland, FL
heroIntro: Wood and vinyl fences cleaned, repaired, and coated so they look sharp again and stand up to damp Chiefland weather.

secondary: vinyl fence cleaning and painting chiefland
questions: Can a green, algae-covered fence be restored?
Is it better to seal or stain a wood fence?

body: Fences in Chiefland tend to fail in one of two ways. On shaded lots, the lower boards and the side facing away from the sun turn green with algae and mildew. In open yards, the wood goes gray and starts to split. Fence staining in Chiefland, FL handles both, but the first step for either is a thorough wash that kills the growth and removes loose gray fibers.

sections.h2: Three ways to finish a fence
bullets: Penetrating stain: soaks into wood, wears gradually, easy to refresh
Clear or lightly tinted sealer: keeps the natural look, needs more frequent recoats
Paint: a solid, uniform color on sound, primed wood
body: For most wood fences here, stain is the practical choice because it does not peel. Paint suits fences close to the house where a matching color matters. Vinyl fences that have faded or yellowed can be cleaned and coated with a product made for vinyl. The crew lead will recommend one approach and list it on your estimate.

There is no point staining a fence that is about to fall over. During prep we re-secure loose boards, replace pickets that are rotted at the ground, and check posts and gates. Rot at grade is common in damp soil, and those boards will fail long before the coating does.
Plantings along the fence line are rinsed and protected, and we watch for overspray onto cars, siding, and neighboring property.

Fences are measured on site. The crew lead notes length, height, board style, how many sides get coated, gates, and the repairs needed. All of that goes on a written estimate with the product named, so you can compare options like staining the street side now and the back run later. A penetrating stain is the usual recommendation for weathered wood, but the estimate lists exactly what we plan to use.

sections.h2: Adding the fence to a bigger project
body: Fences are often added to a deck or exterior job, since the wash and the crew are already on site. Pair it with deck staining in Chiefland or a wash from our Chiefland soft washing service. Our article on treating a sun-damaged wood fence applies just as well in Levy County. For products and methods, see the Florida deck and fence staining page, or visit the Chiefland location page.

faqs.q: Can you restore a green, algae-covered fence?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. We wash and treat the growth, repair rotted boards, and then stain or seal the clean wood.
Yes. Faded vinyl can be cleaned and coated with a product made for vinyl surfaces.
Yes. Loose boards are re-secured and rotted pickets are replaced during prep.

faqs.q: Can I stain just the side of the fence facing the street?
faqs.a: Yes. Each side can be priced separately so you can decide what to include.
